summary.text: Kevin Campbell is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives for District 62 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
His career experience is in oilfield services.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Campbell's career experience includes working in oilfield services, according to Ballotpedia, which also lists his service with the Jesse Martin American Legion Post #009, Wyoming Wool Growers, the Navajo-Churro Sheep Association, the Elks and the Wyoming Historical Society.
Campbell assumed office on January 6, 2025, succeeding Forrest Chadwick.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Minerals, Business and Economic Development Committee and the House Revenue Committee, as well as the matching joint committees.
He defeated Edis Allen in the August 18, 2026 Republican primary, 60.5% to 39.2%.
